Louis Kahn- Adopted
I, Louis Kahn, am in need of a home. I was in pretty rough shape when I was found so I’m still a wee bit concerned in new situations. Since the discovery of being fed inside, I follow my foster mom around and chirp at her for seconds. And maybe thirds! I love to play with my two 7-month old foster brothers. They tire me out, though – you know kids! So here I am; a perfectly gentle package of lovable orange boy who dreams of having a forever home. I don’t wake you up at night or do bad stuff. If you need a lovable chunky bud named after a famous architect, (you can see one of my most famous designs on University of Pennâ€™s campus) you should ask about me! Metalmorphose is your local source for custom wrought iron…with a french twist.
Eric Zandotti, artist and master blacksmith, started
Metalmorphose Iron Works
nearly twenty years ago to bring steel to life in the classical french style.  Wrought Iron is literally in Eric’s blood, his grandfather was a traditional blacksmith in Southern France, and Eric’s talent transcends many styles from classical European to whimiscal and even modern.  Creations from Metalmorphose Iron Works can be found locally throughout Pennsylvania, overseas as far as the French Alps, and online in our
Etsy Store
.
Come visit the Chester County studio near the Brandywine River to discuss your project and see Metalmorphose Iron Works in person.
Metalmorphose Ironworks
is located in Southern Chester County along the scenic Brandywine River, bordering the Cheslen Preserve.
Studio visitations are welcome by appointment or chance.
